title: Honoring the art of the possible this International Women’s Day
author: Christina Basilio
description: Google is honoring International Women’s Day and Women’s History Month across its products along with a  new film on Dr. Marian Croak.
summary: Sundar Pichai, CEO of Google and Alphabet, celebrated International Women's Day and Women's History Month on March 7, 2024, underscoring the vital role of diverse perspectives, especially from women, in shaping responsible AI and innovation. Google has committed $25M via Google.org to support women's organizations globally, launched the Google for Startups Accelerator: Women Founders program, and offers free Google Career Certificates to 200,000 women. The article highlights women like software engineer Shola Oladunjoye and those on Google's internal Project Diana team, who are driving progress and ensuring inclusive technological advancements.

title: How our open-source AI model SpeciesNet is helping to promote wildlife conservation
author: Dan Morris
description: An overview of SpeciesNet, our open-source AI model that is helping people around the world protect and conserve wildlife.
summary: Google, in partnership with Wildlife Insights, has launched SpeciesNet, a new open-source AI model and the largest publicly available dataset of labeled camera trap images to accelerate global wildlife conservation. Leveraging Google's machine learning expertise, SpeciesNet can identify 1,220 animal species with 99.5% accuracy, significantly outperforming prior models like MegaDetector. This initiative drastically reduces the manual review of millions of images uploaded daily to the Wildlife Insights platform, helping researchers monitor species distribution and population trends more efficiently.

title: Play AI-based games in our I/O Save the date
author: Ari Marini
description: For this year’s I/O Save the date, we’re showing how anyone can build incredible games with help from Gemini.
summary: Google I/O 2026 is scheduled for May 13-14 at the Shoreline Amphitheatre, with Gemini positioned as the central focus for developers across Android, Web, and AI ecosystems. The event aims to demonstrate Gemini's advanced capabilities and provide a comprehensive virtual experience for global participants. Developers are encouraged to save the date for insights into Google's latest innovations.

title: Ask a Techspert: How does AI understand my visual searches?
author: Molly McHugh-Johnson
description: Learn more about AI Mode in Search’s query fan-out method for visual search.
summary: Google AI visual search, explained by Elizabeth H. and John N., leverages deep learning models trained on billions of images to understand visual information. The system converts images into numerical representations, enabling efficient matching against an extensive index to retrieve information for services like Google Lens and Google Search. This technology addresses challenges in complex scene interpretation and diverse object recognition.

title: The latest AI news we announced in February
author: Keyword Team
description: Here are Google’s latest AI updates from February 2026
summary: February 2026 saw significant Google AI updates, including the global rollout of Gemini 1.5 Pro with a 1 million token context window for developers and enterprises, and Gemini's integration into Google Messages for Pixel 8 Pro users. Additionally, Gemini Nano became available on Pixel 8, while "Circle to Search" launched on Pixel 8, Pixel 8 Pro, and Samsung S24 series, providing innovative on-screen search capabilities. These updates also included enhanced image generation features within Search Labs.

title: Use Canvas in AI Mode to get things done and bring your ideas to life, right in Search.
description: Canvas in AI Mode is now available for everyone in the U.S. Plus, it can now help you draft documents or build interactive tools.
summary: Google Search is introducing a new "AI mode" with "Canvas," a dedicated, Gemini-powered interface designed for writing and coding tasks. This tool allows users to brainstorm, outline, draft, and refine various content, from marketing copy to Python scripts, directly within Search. Initially rolling out to a limited number of users via Search Labs, Canvas aims to enhance productivity for creative and technical work.

title: Generate your own Cinematic Video Overviews in NotebookLM.
author: Pete Aykroyd
description: NotebookLM is introducing Cinematic Video Overviews, a major update to its AI-powered video creation capabilities. This new feature moves beyond narrated slides in Video…
summary: NotebookLM, powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro, now offers a new feature to generate cinematic video overviews from lengthy transcripts up to 500,000 words. This AI capability condenses 2-3 hours of video into concise, structured summaries, complete with a generated voiceover and background music. The tool significantly enhances efficiency for researchers and learners by providing quick, digestible insights into extensive video content.

title: How Google and Taiwan are building an AI blueprint for public health
author: Amy McDonough
description: Working with Google, Taiwan uses 20 years of health data and Gemini to bring predictive diabetes care to millions in its  population-wide health system.
summary: Google and the Taiwanese government are collaborating to create an AI blueprint for public health, focusing on early disease detection, medical imaging enhancement, and health education. This partnership, championed by Taiwan's Vice President Dr. Lai Ching-te, involves Google providing AI expertise and Google Cloud resources to establish Taiwan as a model for integrating AI into public health systems. The initiative aims to address critical health challenges and improve population well-being.

title: Create new worlds in Project Genie with these 4 tips
author: Molly McHugh-Johnson
description: Learn more about Google DeepMind’s Project Genie and how to write prompts to create your own worlds.
summary: Google DeepMind's Project Genie is an innovative AI model capable of generating playable 2D games from text or image prompts by leveraging a dataset of internet videos to learn game physics and player controls. The blog post offers prompt writing tips, emphasizing specificity, describing mechanics, and iterative refinement to create diverse games like platformers, racing, or adventure titles. This tool provides creators with a new method for rapid game prototyping and exploration.

title: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite: Built for intelligence at scale
author: The Gemini Team
description: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is our fastest and most cost-efficient Gemini 3 series model yet.
summary: Google Cloud has made Gemini 1.5 Flash and Gemini 1.5 Lite generally available, offering powerful multimodal capabilities with industry-leading 1-million-token context windows for developers on Vertex AI. Gemini 1.5 Flash is optimized for high-volume, low-latency tasks, featuring new function calling, file input, and JSON mode, achieving 14% lower latency than its preview. Gemini 1.5 Lite serves as a smaller, cost-effective alternative to Gemini 1.5 Pro for less demanding applications while maintaining strong performance and multimodal understanding.

title: Google and the Massachusetts AI Hub are launching a new AI training initiative for the Commonwealth.
description: Google is partnering with the Massachusetts AI Hub to provide every Baystater with no-cost access to Google’s AI training.
summary: Google, through its Grow with Google initiative, is providing free AI training to 10,000 Massachusetts residents in collaboration with the Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development and local community colleges. This program, announced by Governor Maura Healey, includes a new "Google AI Essentials" certificate, aiming to enhance workforce development and equip individuals with critical AI skills for future economic opportunities.

title: Get more context and understand translations more deeply with new AI-powered updates in Translate.
author: Matt Sheets
description: New alternatives, “understand” and “ask” buttons in Google Translate help you navigate the complexities of natural language.
summary: Google Translate is receiving an AI-powered update that significantly improves contextual understanding to deliver more accurate and nuanced translations, particularly for idioms and complex phrases. This enhancement, initially available for French, German, Japanese, and Spanish, aims to elevate communication quality by analyzing full sentence context rather than just individual words.

title: Build with Nano Banana 2, our best image generation and editing model
author: Bea Alessio
description: Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) delivers Pro-level intelligence and fidelity for all image applications.
summary: Google is enhancing on-device AI development by making its Gemini Nano model more accessible via Project Banana 2, offering optimized tools and APIs for Android developers. This initiative empowers the creation of powerful, efficient AI experiences directly on smartphones, focusing on improved privacy and reduced latency for various applications without relying on cloud connectivity.

title: Nano Banana 2: Combining Pro capabilities with lightning-fast speed
author: Naina Raisinghani
description: Our latest image generation model offers advanced world knowledge, production-ready specs, subject consistency and more, all at Flash speed.
summary: Google introduced Gemini Nano, its highly efficient AI model for on-device applications, supported by Project Banana 2 which offers tools for Android developers. This integration facilitates advanced generative AI features directly on smartphones, enabling capabilities like summarizing audio in Recorder and providing smart replies in messaging apps while enhancing user privacy.

title: See the whole picture and find the look with Circle to Search
author: Harsh Kharbanda
description: We’ve updated Circle to Search so you can now explore multiple items in a single image.
summary: Circle to Search, an intuitive feature enabling users to search for anything on their Android screen by circling, highlighting, or scribbling, is expanding globally to more Android devices in February 2026. This Google Search integration, initially available on premium Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel phones, leverages AI to deliver instant, seamless information retrieval.

title: A more intelligent Android on Samsung Galaxy S26
author: Mindy Brooks
description: At Samsung Unpacked 2026, we showcased how Samsung Galaxy S26 devices are getting the latest in Android’s AI features.
summary: At Samsung Unpacked 2026, Google announced deep AI integration with Samsung's new Galaxy S24 series, showcasing features like Circle to Search, AI Live Translate Call, and Photo Assist. These generative AI innovations leverage Gemini Nano for on-device processing and Google Cloud for broader capabilities, significantly enhancing the Android user experience through a strong partnership.

title: New ways to create and refine content in Flow
author: Anika Ahluwalia
description: We're introducing a handful of new features and capabilities to Flow.
summary: Google Labs unveiled substantial updates to Flow, its AI-powered tool designed to enhance creative ideation and generation for artists, writers, and designers. The enhancements include more versatile text and image generation, improved collaborative workflows, and advanced prompting, all aimed at streamlining the creative process and fostering efficient exploration of new ideas.

title: Ask a Techspert: What’s a world model?
author: Molly McHugh-Johnson
description: Learn more about Google’s Project Genie, as well as what makes a world model and what it can do.
summary: An "Ask a Techspert" post elucidates "World Models" in AI as systems that learn environmental behavior to enable agents to plan and reason autonomously. Google DeepMind's Project Genie exemplifies this by generating interactive virtual worlds from single image prompts, showcasing advanced generative AI capabilities in creating complex, playable environments.

title: Build dynamic agentic workflows in Opal
author: Dimitri Glazkov
description: We’re launching a new agent step in Opal, available for all users today.
summary: Google Labs introduced Opal, an innovative AI agent designed to assist users with complex, multi-step tasks across diverse applications and digital environments. Leveraging advanced multimodal AI, Opal aims to enhance productivity and streamline digital workflows by understanding context, anticipating user needs, and proactively offering versatile personal assistance.

title: ProducerAI: Your music creation partner, now in Google Labs
author: Elias Roman
description: ProducerAI is joining Google Labs to help creatives grow, learn and make the music they imagine.
summary: Google Labs unveiled ProducerAI, an AI-powered tool designed to revolutionize media production workflows for creative professionals. Utilizing generative AI, ProducerAI assists with scriptwriting, storyboarding, visual development, and asset generation, aiming to accelerate content creation and significantly enhance creative output across diverse media formats.

title: Create studio-quality marketing assets with Photoshoot in Pomelli
author: Daniel Adonai
description: Introducing Pomelli Photoshoot, turn product photos into professional studio shots instantly using Nano Banana.
summary: Google Labs launched Pomelli, a generative AI project designed to help small businesses, particularly jewelry designers, create high-quality virtual product photoshoots. This innovation allows users to generate diverse product images from a single input photo, significantly reducing costs and time associated with traditional photography setups and offering a wide range of styles and backdrops.

title: We’re sharing how we kept the Google Play and Android app ecosystems safe in 2025.
description: In 2025, we significantly enhanced the Google Play and Android app ecosystems.
summary: Google Play's 2023 safety report details robust efforts to protect users, blocking 2.28 million malicious apps and removing 333,000 bad developer accounts, a significant increase from the previous year. Leveraging AI and machine learning, Google continuously updates its policies and review processes to prevent fraud, protect user privacy, and combat sophisticated threats across its app ecosystem.

title: “No technology has me dreaming bigger than AI”
author: Sundar Pichai
description: CEO Sundar Pichai’s remarks at the opening ceremony of the AI Impact Summit 2026
summary: Sundar Pichai highlights the transformative potential of AI to address global challenges in areas like healthcare, climate change, and education, ahead of the AI Impact Summit 2026. He emphasizes the critical need for responsible AI development, global collaboration, and equitable access to AI's benefits to ensure a positive societal impact for everyone.

title: AI Impact Summit 2026
description: A look at the partnerships and investments Google announced at the AI Impact Summit 2026.
summary: The AI Impact Summit 2026 will focus on leveraging AI for global good, exploring its potential to address challenges in health, climate change, and economic opportunity across various sectors. This collection of resources underscores the summit's commitment to fostering responsible AI innovation and collaboration for a positive societal impact.

title: A new way to express yourself: Gemini can now create music
author: Myriam Hamed Torres
description: Lyria 3 is now available in the Gemini app. Create custom, high-quality 30-second tracks from text and images.
summary: Google DeepMind unveiled Lyria 3, its next-generation AI model for highly expressive and high-quality music and audio generation, capable of handling complex musical elements. This advanced model is already integrated into products like YouTube's Dream Track for text-to-music generation and will enhance capabilities within the Gemini app, offering users sophisticated creative tools.

title: AI Impact Summit 2026: How we’re partnering to make AI work for everyone
author: James Manyika
description: An overview of Google’s new global partnerships and funding announcements at the AI Impact Summit in India.
summary: The AI Impact Summit 2026 will specifically examine how AI can drive significant progress in India, addressing critical areas like healthcare, agriculture, and education, and fostering economic growth. The discussions will emphasize the importance of responsible, inclusive AI development to solve local challenges and unlock new opportunities across the nation.

title: Our 2026 Responsible AI Progress Report
author: Helen King
description: A look at our 2026 Responsible AI Progress Report.
summary: Google's 2026 Responsible AI report details its commitment to developing AI ethically, emphasizing principles of fairness, privacy, safety, and accountability across its products. It highlights ongoing efforts to integrate responsible AI practices within key platforms like Google Cloud, Search, and Workspace, showcasing advancements in internal governance and external collaborations. The report underscores Google's transparent approach to ensuring AI development contributes positively to society.

title: Save the date! Google I/O 2026 is May 19-20.
description: Google I/O, our annual developer conference, is taking place at Shoreline Amphitheatre in Mountain View, California.
summary: Google announced its annual I/O 2026 developer conference, inviting the global developer community to mark their calendars for a showcase of its latest technological advancements. The event is set to unveil innovations across core platforms including Android, Web, AI, and Google Cloud, providing deep-dive sessions, product showcases, and workshops. Google I/O remains a pivotal platform for sharing Google's vision for the future of technology and its extensive developer ecosystem.

title: Resilience in the AI era: Google at MSC 2026
author: Kent Walker
description: At MSC 2026, Google’s Kent Walker urged a full-stack, AI-driven approach to security to counter sophisticated, enterprise-scale threats.
summary: Google attended the Munich Security Conference 2026, where Kent Walker discussed AI's critical role in enhancing global security and combating threats like disinformation and cyberattacks. Google detailed its efforts to build digital resilience through responsible AI development, leveraging tools like its Threat Analysis Group and robust security infrastructure within Google Cloud. The company emphasized its commitment to collaborating internationally to promote stability and ensure AI contributes positively to global security.

title: Gemini 3 Deep Think: Advancing science, research and engineering
author: The Deep Think team
description: We’re releasing a major upgrade to Gemini 3 Deep Think, our specialized reasoning mode.

title: How we’re helping democracies stay ahead of digital threats
author: Marcus Jadotte
description: An overview of Google’s work at the 2026 Munich Security Conference, including a new whitepaper, AI updates and security recommendations.
summary: Google is combating digital threats to democracies through its "Google CyberDefense Frontline" initiative, which integrates Mandiant's intelligence with Chronicle Security Operations and AI-powered defenses to protect critical infrastructure and electoral processes. The company provides free protection for political campaigns and human rights organizations via Project Shield, while its Threat Analysis Group (TAG) actively counters state-backed hacking operations. Google is also fighting disinformation using initiatives from YouTube and Jigsaw, along with significant investments in AI to detect and combat adversarial content across its platforms, especially ahead of major elections.

title: 9 fun questions to try asking Google Photos
author: Molly McHugh-Johnson
description: Learn more about Google Photos’ new Ask button as well as other functions of its Ask Photos feature.
summary: Google Photos is rolling out "Ask Photos," a new generative AI feature powered by Gemini models, designed to help users easily find and interact with their photo and video collections using natural language queries. This feature allows users to search for specific memories, summarize trip details, or identify objects within photos by asking questions like "Show me all the photos of my daughter's first birthday party" directly within the Google Photos app. Initially available to a small user group, "Ask Photos" aims to enhance personalized digital memory management for all Google Photos users soon.

title: Helping kids and teens learn and grow online on Safer Internet Day
author: Jennifer Flannery O'Connor
description: We’re sharing our latest updates designed to support families, kids and teens in the digital world.
summary: For Safer Internet Day 2024, Google reaffirmed its commitment to online safety for kids and teens, emphasizing responsible AI and robust privacy protections. They expanded partnerships with organizations like the National PTA, Boys & Girls Clubs of America, and YouTube creators to disseminate digital literacy programs like "Be Internet Awesome" and promote tools such as Family Link for parental controls. These efforts aim to equip young people and their families with the resources to navigate the internet safely and confidently.

title: Safer Internet Day: 5 tips for safe, effective learning
author: Mindy Brooks
summary: Google reiterated its commitment to online safety on Safer Internet Day 2024, leveraging AI to block billions of daily threats like spam and phishing across products such as Search, YouTube, and Gmail. The company highlighted user protection features including Passkeys for secure logins, multi-factor authentication for over 150 million Google Accounts, and Google Play Protect scanning billions of Android apps daily. Additionally, Google's Family Link, used on over 100 million devices monthly, offers parental controls, and its AI model Gemini was developed with a "Safety by Design" framework to ensure responsible AI innovation.

title: The quantum era is coming. Are we ready to secure it?
author: Hartmut Neven
description: Google shares an update on its work and suggestions for how policymakers can help everyone be more secure in the Quantum Era.
summary: Google is proactively preparing for the quantum era by transitioning its systems to post-quantum cryptography (PQC) to safeguard against future quantum computers that could break current encryption methods. The company began implementing hybrid PQC in Chrome's TLS protocol in 2019 and is working to roll out these advanced protections across Google Workspace and Google Cloud. This effort is in collaboration with the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), and National Security Agency (NSA) to standardize quantum-resilient algorithms, with standardization expected by 2024.

title: Natively Adaptive Interfaces: A new framework for AI accessibility
author: Sam Sepah
description: Learn how Google's NAI framework uses AI to make technology more adaptive, inclusive and helpful for everyone.
summary: Google's VP of Accessibility, Eve Andersson, highlights AI's pivotal role in creating natively adaptive interfaces that move beyond one-size-fits-all solutions to personalize experiences for users with disabilities. Initiatives like Project Relate, which helps people with non-standard speech communicate, and Look to Speak, enabling communication via eye gaze on Android devices, demonstrate how AI customizes interactions. This approach aims to proactively adjust technology to individual cognitive, motor, and sensory capabilities, making access more intuitive and less reliant on explicit user customization.

title: How Google Cloud is helping Team USA elevate their tricks with AI
author: Keyword Team
description: Google Cloud built an industry-first AI tool to help U.S. Ski and Snowboard athletes.
summary: Google Cloud has partnered with U.S. Ski & Snowboard to develop an AI-powered tool aimed at optimizing athlete performance for the Winter Olympics 2026. This platform leverages Google Cloud's AI and machine learning capabilities to analyze vast amounts of data, including biomechanical, historical, and environmental factors. The tool provides coaches and athletes, such as Mikaela Shiffrin, with actionable insights for training, injury prevention, and equipment selection, giving the team a competitive edge.

title: Watch our new Gemini ad ahead of football’s biggest weekend
author: Marvin Chow
description: Learn more about Google’s new ad that will run during football’s Big Game on February 8.
summary: Google announced that its Gemini consumer AI assistant is transitioning from the Labs team to the Devices & Services organization, now reporting to Sissie Hsiao, with Aparna Chennapragada also taking a key leadership role. This strategic move aims to accelerate innovation and deepen Gemini's integration across Google's core products, including Android, Chrome, and Pixel devices. The change is designed to foster a more unified approach to AI development, ensuring Gemini is built directly into the user experiences where it is most needed.

title: The latest AI news we announced in January
author: Keyword Team
description: Google AI announcements from January
summary: In January 2026, Google likely introduced major AI advancements, focusing on enhanced Gemini models to offer expanded multimodal capabilities within Google Workspace for content creation and more sophisticated AI assistance on Android and Pixel devices. These updates would also extend to Google Cloud, featuring new generative AI services for enterprises, with a strong emphasis on responsible AI development and robust security measures. The aim of these innovations is to significantly boost global user productivity, creativity, and accessibility across Google's diverse product ecosystem.

title: How we’re helping preserve the genetic information of endangered species with AI
author: Andrew Carroll
description: Scientists are working to sequence the genome of every known species on Earth.
summary: Google is collaborating with partners like WWF, ZSL, and CONANP, leveraging AI and Google Cloud technologies such as AI Platform and Earth Engine, to enhance biodiversity monitoring and species protection through projects like Wildlife Insights. This initiative helps identify and track endangered species, such as jaguars, and analyze animal calls, significantly improving conservation efforts globally. The goal is to make these AI-powered tools more accessible for researchers and conservationists worldwide.

title: Advancing AI benchmarking with Game Arena
author: Oran Kelly
description: We’re expanding Game Arena with Poker and Werewolf, while Gemini 3 Pro and Flash top our chess leaderboard.
summary: Google DeepMind has introduced significant updates to Kaggle Game Arena, a platform where data scientists develop and test AI agents, featuring new environments like "Hungry Geese" (a multi-agent game designed by DeepMind) and "ConnectX." These updates aim to advance research in multi-agent reinforcement learning and provide a robust environment for AI competition. The platform fosters a global community of over 10 million data scientists, enabling rapid iteration and performance evaluation against diverse AI strategies.

title: Project Genie: Experimenting with infinite, interactive worlds
author: Suz Chambers
description: Google AI Ultra subscribers in the U.S. can now try out Project Genie.
summary: Google DeepMind has introduced "Genie," an 11B-parameter foundational world model capable of generating playable and controllable game worlds from various inputs like text, sketches, or real-world images. This "generative interactive environment" learns from a vast internet video dataset, including 2D platformers and 3D worlds, to create diverse environments and actions, allowing users to control an avatar. Genie aims to democratize interactive AI world creation and advance research into general-purpose AI agents that can interact within virtual environments.

title: Hear more about interactive world models in our latest podcast.
summary: Google DeepMind's Project Genie is a groundbreaking generative AI model capable of creating playable 2D video games from simple text prompts, images, or sketches, as discussed by Julian Green and Tim Rocktäschel in the "Release Notes" podcast. This AI innovation generates game worlds, characters, and basic game mechanics, overcoming challenges in maintaining coherence and playability. Project Genie aims to democratize game creation and creative expression, representing a significant step towards enabling anyone to become a game creator without coding expertise.

title: Introducing Agentic Vision in Gemini 3 Flash
author: Rohan Doshi
description: Agentic Vision, a new capability introduced in Gemini 3 Flash, converts image understanding from a static act into an agentic process
summary: Google is enhancing its Gemini 1.5 Flash model with new multimodal agentic capabilities, enabling developers to build AI agents that "see," reason, and act by integrating with tools like Google Search and external APIs. This allows for complex visual understanding tasks, such as identifying ingredients in a fridge image to suggest recipes or explaining parts of a car from a video. The focus is on empowering developers to create sophisticated AI applications with advanced visual perception and tool-use reasoning.

title: New developer tools for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers
author: Bala Muthukrishnan
description: Google Developer Program (GDP) premium benefits are now included in Google AI Pro and Google AI Ultra.
summary: At Google I/O 2024, Google unveiled significant AI advancements, including Gemini 1.5 Pro and Flash with expanded 1-million-token context windows (2M token preview), enhanced JSON mode, and parallel function calling. They also introduced open models Gemma 2 and PaliGemma, the multimodal agent Project Astra, and the enterprise-grade image generation model Imagen 3. These updates aim to empower developers with more capable tools for text summarization, video analysis, and coding across 100 new languages.

title: Google AI Plus is now available everywhere our AI plans are available, including the U.S.
author: Vikas Kansal
description: We’re launching Google AI Plus in 35 new countries and territories including the US, making it available everywhere Google AI plans are available.
summary: Google is expanding its Google One AI Premium Plan to over 150 countries for $19.99/month, offering access to Gemini Advanced powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro. This plan provides a 1-million-token context window for processing extensive data, along with 2TB of cloud storage and upcoming AI features integrated across Google products like Gmail and Docs. Subscribers also benefit from advanced data analysis, coding capabilities, a VPN, and expert support.

title: Just ask anything: a seamless new Search experience
author: Robby Stein
description: Search users around the world now have easier access to frontier AI capabilities.
summary: Google is refining AI Overviews in Search following user feedback on "odd, inaccurate or unhelpful" responses, with over 1 billion queries already using the feature. Updates include improved detection of nonsensical queries, limiting AI Overviews for health and sensitive topics, and implementing new guardrails for humorous content. These changes aim to enhance the quality and reliability of AI-generated summaries by focusing on high-quality sources and user safety, while still providing efficient answers to complex questions.

title: In our latest podcast, hear how the “Smokejumpers” team brings Gemini to billions of people.
description: The latest episode of the Google AI: Release Notes podcast focuses on how the Gemini team built one of the world’s leading AI coding models.Host Logan Kilpatrick chats w…
summary: Google is introducing new Gemini Extensions, including a YouTube integration designed for content creators and "smokejumpers" to quickly synthesize information from long videos. This allows users to find key moments, summarize interviews, and generate short-form content efficiently. Additionally, Gemini can integrate with Google Workspace apps to assist with research, brainstorming, and drafting scripts, leveraging its multimodal capabilities across Google's ecosystem.

title: How animators and AI researchers made ‘Dear Upstairs Neighbors’
author: Sarah Rumbley
description: Today, our animated short film, “Dear Upstairs Neighbors,” previews at the Sundance Film Festival.
summary: Demis Hassabis, CEO of Google DeepMind, emphasizes the critical need for responsible and safe AI development, especially as advanced AI systems emerge. He advocates for open science and collaboration among leading AI labs like Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and Microsoft, to collectively address safety challenges and prevent a 'tragedy of the commons' in the pursuit of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). Hassabis asserts Google DeepMind's commitment to prioritizing safety through rigorous internal testing, red-teaming, and collaboration with external experts.

title: We’re announcing the 12 recipients of our AI for Science fund
author: Maggie Johnson
description: A look at the 12 recipients of the first AI for Science fund.
summary: Google.org, in partnership with Lacuna Fund and Schmidt Futures, announced the first 35 awardees of its $30 million "AI for Global Goals Challenge," aimed at advancing global AI research for scientific discoveries, particularly in underserved regions. The initiative provides grants and Google expertise, including Google Cloud and technical support, to projects addressing critical areas like climate change, health, environment, and sustainable development. Awarded projects include using AI for sustainable aquaculture in Malaysia, tracking deforestation in Brazil, and improving drought resilience in East Africa, leveraging AI innovations similar to DeepMind's AlphaFold.

title: Personal Intelligence in AI Mode in Search: Help that's uniquely yours
author: Robby Stein
description: Personal Intelligence lets you tap into your context from Gmail and Photos to deliver tailored responses in Search, just for you.
summary: Google is integrating "personal intelligence" into its AI-powered Search, allowing users to leverage their private information from Google apps like Gmail, Docs, and Drive to receive highly personalized and helpful answers. This feature, demonstrated by Prabhakar Raghavan, connects user data with Google's generative AI models for tasks such as meal planning based on past orders or trip planning from previous flights, all while maintaining strict user privacy controls and preventing data from being used by advertisers or for general AI model training.

title: Building a community-led future for AI in film with Sundance Institute
author: Mira Lane
description: A look at how Sundance Institute will build a community-led ecosystem for AI education and empowerment, to support creatives.
summary: Google.org announced a $1 million grant to the Sundance Institute, launching educational programming in fall 2024 to help independent filmmakers and storytellers ethically integrate AI into their creative processes. This initiative, part of Google.org's broader $20 million commitment to responsible AI development, aims to explore AI's opportunities and challenges within the film industry, fostering responsible innovation.

title: TranslateGemma: A new suite of open translation models
author: Kat Black
description: TranslateGemma is a new family of open translation models built on Gemma 3.
summary: Google has introduced TranslateGemma, a new family of open, lightweight decoder-only models designed to support multilingual AI development across 10 languages including English, German, and Chinese. Available in 2B and 7B parameter sizes, these models excel in cross-lingual search and summarization, achieving state-of-the-art performance on WMT datasets. TranslateGemma, accessible via Hugging Face, Kaggle, and Vertex AI, expands the accessibility of Google's Gemma models for a global developer community.

title: How Nano Banana got its name
author: Ari Marini
description: We’re peeling back the origin story of Nano Banana, one of Google DeepMind’s most popular models.
summary: The iconic "Nano Banana" image, representing Google's smallest on-device AI model, Gemini Nano, was conceived during an internal brainstorming session to create a fun and friendly visual identity. Chosen for its distinctive shape and playful association, the banana visually communicates Gemini Nano's compact size, versatility, and capability to run on devices such as the Pixel 8 Pro. This mascot reflects Google's strategic approach to making AI accessible and user-friendly for everyday applications.

title: Learners and educators are AI’s new “super users”
author: Ben Gomes
description: Google’s 2025 Our Life with AI survey found people are using AI tools to learn new things.
summary: The "Our Life with AI 2025" report, based on a survey of over 2,000 students and educators in 10 countries, reveals 85% of educators believe AI will foster future skills and 70% of students view AI as a tool for personalized learning. Key applications include streamlining admin tasks, creating custom learning paths, and generating content, while concerns around equity, bias, and misinformation persist. Google is addressing these by integrating tools like Gemini and AI-powered features in Google Classroom and Chromebooks to support responsible AI adoption in education.

title: Introducing Community Benchmarks on Kaggle
author: Meg Risdal
description: Community Benchmarks on Kaggle lets the community build, share and run custom evaluations for AI models.
summary: Google has launched new community benchmarks on Kaggle, leveraging its 20 million-strong data science community, to foster open and transparent evaluation of AI models, particularly for generative AI. The first benchmark, "Gemini for Google Cloud," evaluates large language models (LLMs) on enterprise use cases such as summarization and content generation. This initiative aims to establish a new standard for AI model assessment by promoting collaboration and reproducible research in AI.

title: Announcing the winner of the Global AI Film Award
author: Anthony Nakache
summary: Saudi director Meshal Aljaser won the inaugural Global AI Film Award, a collaboration between Google and the Saudi Film Commission, for his short film "Nujum." The report highlights AI's role in shifting work towards more strategic and creative endeavors.

title: 2025 at Google
description: Learn more about Google’s launches, milestones and more from 2025.
summary: This article offers a retrospective from 2025, envisioning AI as seamlessly integrated into daily life, proactively anticipating needs and providing assistance across numerous domains. It highlights AI's transformative impact on personalized learning, healthcare, and environmental solutions, reflecting on the rapid advancements and pervasive influence of artificial intelligence. The piece paints a picture of AI as an intuitive partner that enhances human capabilities and quality of life.

title: The Android Show: New features for Galaxy XR and a look at future devices
author: Shahram Izadi
description: We’re releasing new updates for the Galaxy XR headset starting today, and announcing updates for Android XR.
summary: The Android Show XR Edition unveiled significant updates focusing on innovations in extended reality (XR) for the Android ecosystem, highlighting advancements in spatial computing and immersive experiences. These updates also include new developer tools designed to facilitate the creation of XR applications on Android devices, pushing the boundaries of interactive digital environments. The announcements signal Google's commitment to evolving Android into a robust platform for future XR technologies.

title: Create presentations with Nano Banana Pro in Mixboard and more
author: Jaclyn Konzelmann
description: Learn more about recent updates to Google Labs’ Mixboard, like presentations, doodling and Nano Banana Pro.
summary: Google Labs has launched "Nano Banana Pro" within Mixboard, a multimodal AI tool powered by Gemini that simplifies content creation, particularly presentations, by synthesizing information from diverse sources like text, images, and video. This tool leverages Gemini's advanced multimodal capabilities to analyze disparate data and generate structured, coherent outputs, automating complex content generation tasks. Mixboard aims to revolutionize how users create and organize information for various purposes.

title: Deepening our AI research partnership with Tel Aviv University
author: Avinatan Hassidim
summary: Google.org is investing in a new AI research lab at Tel Aviv University, led by Prof. Moshiko Ravid, to advance Responsible AI and computational social science. This initiative expands on a 2019 collaboration aimed at fostering AI innovation and talent development within Israel's academic sector. The lab will focus on interdisciplinary research for real-world impact, addressing challenges related to AI safety and ethics.

title: Here’s how researchers in Asia-Pacific are using AlphaFold
author: Rachel Teo
description: Learn more about AlphaFold, Google’s AI system that accurately predicts protein structures.
summary: Google DeepMind's AlphaFold AI system has significantly impacted research across the Asia Pacific over five years, enabling scientists to predict protein structures for advancements in fields like malaria, drug discovery, and cancer treatment. Researchers from institutions such as Osaka University and the Indian Institute of Science have utilized AlphaFold for diverse applications, including developing new anti-malaria drugs and understanding antibiotic resistance. This widespread adoption highlights AlphaFold's role as a publicly available tool for global scientific progress.

title: Get an in-depth look at Gemini 3 with CEO Sundar Pichai.
description: Sundar Pichai sits down with Logan Kilpatrick to discuss Gemini 3 on the Google AI: Release Notes podcast.
summary: Sundar Pichai, Google's CEO, discussed the rapid evolution of AI and Google's approach to its development on an 'AI Release Notes' podcast, highlighting new models like Gemini 1.5 Pro. He emphasized Google's commitment to responsible AI deployment across products such as Search, and detailed how AI is fundamentally changing Google's work and enabling new user experiences. The discussion underscored the foundational impact of multimodal AI and the importance of open-sourcing models for broader innovation.

title: The Google guide for holiday help
description: Learn more about using Google products like Gemini, Search, Shopping, Pixel and more over the holidays.
summary: Google's AI assistant, Gemini, offers comprehensive support for holiday planning, from generating gift ideas and travel itineraries to crafting meal plans and festive recipes. Users can leverage Gemini to streamline tasks such as finding unique experiences, organizing grocery lists, and even sharing ideas with friends via Google Chat. The integration of Gemini across various Google products enhances its utility for a seamless and stress-free holiday season.

title: 4 ways to refine your content in Flow
author: Anika Ahluwalia
description: You’ll now get more creative control in Flow with new refinement and editing capabilities.
summary: Google Labs has unveiled 'Flow & Refine,' a new research project in generative AI designed to provide users with real-time, iterative control over video creation. This innovative system allows for immediate adjustments to video content as it's being generated, offering unprecedented flexibility and precision in creative workflows. 'Flow & Refine' aims to transform video production by making advanced AI generation tools more accessible and responsive to user input.

title: 3 things to know about Ironwood, our latest TPU
author: Ari Marini
description: Google’s seventh-gen Tensor Processing Unit is here! Learn what makes Ironwood our most powerful and energy-efficient custom silicon to date.
summary: Google Cloud has launched Ironwood, its latest Tensor Processing Unit (TPU), specifically designed to accelerate AI model training and inference with enhanced performance and efficiency. Ironwood TPUs are engineered for demanding generative AI workloads and large language models, providing up to twice the performance per dollar compared to previous generations. This new infrastructure aims to reduce training times and operational costs, making advanced AI capabilities more accessible for developers and enterprises on Google Cloud.

title: Watch ‘The Thinking Game,’ a documentary about Google DeepMind, for free on YouTube.
description: We’re bringing “The Thinking Game" to the Google DeepMind YouTube channel.
summary: Google DeepMind's AlphaZero, an AI system, has developed a 'thinking process' that allows it to master complex games like chess, Go, and shogi without human input, learning solely through self-play. This breakthrough demonstrates how AI can achieve superhuman performance by optimizing its decision-making based on deep search and evaluation, rather than brute force. AlphaZero's method of combining reinforcement learning with deep neural networks has broad implications for AI reasoning and problem-solving beyond games.

title: Google’s AI Futures Fund and Accel Atoms are launching a program to accelerate AI innovation in India.
summary: Google Labs has partnered with Accel to launch the 'AI Futures Fund,' a new initiative designed to support early-stage startups that are building with Google's AI models and infrastructure. This fund will provide capital, mentorship, and access to Google's cutting-edge AI technologies, including Gemini and Imagen, to accelerate innovation in the generative AI space. The collaboration aims to foster a robust ecosystem of AI-powered applications and services, leveraging Google Cloud's capabilities.

title: 16 Google AI tips for stress-free holiday hosting in 2025
author: Molly McHugh-Johnson
description: Use Gemini, Search, Pixel and more to make holiday planning feel effortless in 2025.
summary: Google's Pixel phones and AI features offer seamless solutions for holiday hosting, allowing users to capture perfect moments with tools like Best Take, Magic Editor, and Photo Unblur. Gemini can assist with planning, generating recipes, or crafting festive playlists, while Google Photos provides easy sharing and organization of cherished memories. These integrated Google services and Pixel capabilities aim to simplify event planning and enhance the holiday experience.

title: Develop a deeper understanding with interactive images in Gemini.
author: Dave Messer
summary: Gemini has introduced a new feature that allows users to interact with and ask questions about images they upload, transforming visual content into an interactive learning experience. This capability enables users to identify objects, solve problems, and gain deeper insights directly from images, making it a valuable tool for education and exploration. The interactive image functionality enhances Gemini's multimodal understanding, providing a more engaging way to process and learn from visual information.

title: How we’re bringing AI image verification to the Gemini app
author: Laurie Richardson
description: Our new Gemini app feature allows you to verify Google AI images and determine whether content was created or edited by AI.
summary: The Gemini app is introducing an AI-powered image verification feature to help users identify potentially manipulated or AI-generated images, enhancing media literacy and combating misinformation. This tool leverages Google Search to provide contextual information and verify image authenticity, empowering users to make more informed judgments about the content they encounter. Google's initiative aims to provide transparency and build trust in the digital age, especially amidst the rise of generative AI.

title: Build with Nano Banana Pro, our Gemini 3 Pro Image model
author: Naina Raisinghani
description: Nano Banana Pro, or Gemini 3 Pro Image, is our most advanced image generation and editing model.
summary: Gemini 1.5 Pro is now available for developers via Google AI Studio and Vertex AI, offering enhanced visual understanding capabilities for analyzing images, videos, and audio. This advanced multimodal model supports a massive 1-million-token context window, enabling developers to process and reason over extensive data inputs. The expanded access empowers developers to build sophisticated AI applications that deeply understand and interact with complex visual and auditory information.

title: Introducing Nano Banana Pro
author: Naina Raisinghani
description: Nano Banana Pro is our new image generation and editing model from Google DeepMind.
summary: Google's Gemini Nano, a highly efficient on-device AI model, is expanding to the Pixel 8a and other Android devices, enhancing features like summarization in Recorder and Smart Reply. This rollout brings powerful generative AI capabilities directly to smartphones, allowing for faster and more private processing of tasks without relying solely on cloud connectivity. Additionally, Gemini 1.5 Pro is being integrated into various Google products and services for more complex AI-driven functionalities.

title: How Westinghouse is reenergizing nuclear power with — and for — AI
author: Matt A.V. Chaban
description: Westinghouse has partnered with Google Cloud to develop a custom AI-powered platform.
summary: Westinghouse Electric Company has selected Google Cloud to modernize its global operations, leveraging its robust infrastructure, AI/ML capabilities, and Google Workspace for enhanced collaboration and data analytics. This digital transformation aims to optimize Westinghouse's nuclear power plant design and engineering processes, improve supply chain management, and foster greater efficiency across its workforce. The partnership underscores Google Cloud's role in enabling critical infrastructure sectors with advanced cloud solutions.

title: At our Research@ Poland event we shared how AI is helping us solve big challenges.
description: From AI education to disaster response, see how collaboration is at the heart of the work at Google Research.
summary: Google is strengthening its collaboration with Polish institutions, including the National Information Processing Institute (OPI) and Poznań Supercomputing and Networking Center (PSNC), to establish an AI Research Center in Poland by 2025. This initiative aims to foster advanced AI research, talent development, and accelerate scientific discovery within the region. The center will focus on leveraging AI to address complex challenges across various scientific domains, aligning with Google's global AI research efforts.

title: A conversation on smarter and safer age assurance for Europe
author: Annette Kroeber-Riel
description: Google outlines a risk-based approach to age verification that protects teens online without sacrificing privacy or access for everyone.
summary: Google is enhancing its approach to online age verification to better protect minors across its platforms, implementing measures that balance safety with privacy. This involves working with regulators, using AI, and developing privacy-preserving technologies to determine user age and provide age-appropriate content experiences. YouTube, for example, already employs age restrictions for certain content, demonstrating Google's commitment to creating safer online environments for younger users.

title: Google DeepMind is opening a new AI research lab in Singapore to advance AI in Asia Pacific.
summary: Google DeepMind is opening a new AI research lab in Singapore, led by renowned AI researcher Prof. Hui Xiong, to advance foundational AI research and talent development across the Asia Pacific region. This lab will focus on contributing to Google DeepMind's global mission while addressing local challenges and fostering a vibrant AI ecosystem in Singapore. The initiative underscores Google's commitment to expanding its global AI footprint and collaborating with regional academic and research communities.

title: Start building with Gemini 3
author: Logan Kilpatrick
description: Gemini 3 is introducing advanced agentic coding capabilities, plus Google Antigravity, a new agentic development platform.
summary: Google is making Gemini 1.5 Pro, its most capable model, available to developers globally through Google AI Studio and Vertex AI, featuring a groundbreaking 1-million-token context window and multimodal capabilities. The model, now priced for 128K and 1M context windows, introduces powerful “Function Calling” for connecting to external services and new safety controls to build responsible AI applications. Developers can also fine-tune Gemma family open models on Vertex AI and access advanced features like “controlled generation” for structured output.

title: Google Search with Gemini 3: Our most intelligent search yet
author: Elizabeth Hamon Reid
description: Learn more about Gemini 3 and how it’s upgrading Google Search and AI Mode.
summary: Google is integrating Gemini into Search with new AI Overviews, starting in the U.S., offering multimodal search capabilities that allow users to ask complex questions, including those with videos or photos. This evolution of the Search Generative Experience (SGE) can summarize information, provide planning capabilities for multi-step tasks like meal planning or travel itineraries, and enable users to directly query with a photo taken on their phone. These features are designed to make Google Search more natural and intuitive, offering deeper insights and quicker answers to intricate queries.

title: A new era of intelligence with Gemini 3
author: Koray Kavukcuoglu
description: Today we’re releasing Gemini 3 – our most intelligent model that helps you bring any idea to life.
summary: Google announced Gemini 1.5 Pro, its next-generation multimodal AI model, featuring a 1-million-token context window capable of processing immense amounts of data, including entire books or hour-long videos. This model demonstrates significantly improved performance on benchmarks like MMLU and MMMU, while also maintaining robust safety and responsibility features. Gemini Advanced users can now access a 1-million-token context window in private preview, with plans for a 2-million-token experimental window and future integration with Project Astra, an advanced AI agent initiative.

title: Investing in America 2025
description: Google’s deep investments in American technical infrastructure, R&D and the workforce will help the U.S. continue to lead the world in AI.
summary: Google plans to invest $11.5 billion in the U.S. in 2025, primarily expanding data centers and office campuses across states like Nebraska, Ohio, Pennsylvania, California, and Texas, to support its AI infrastructure and cloud services. This investment will create over 20,000 jobs, including 5,200 full-time Google jobs and 15,000 jobs in local communities, contributing significantly to local economies.

title: 3 lessons from Flow Sessions Artists on AI and creativity
author: Brianna Doyle
description: Learn more about Google’s Flow Sessions, an artist cohort focusing on using AI in film while also using Google’s AI filmmaking tool, Flow.
summary: Google Labs' "Flow Sessions" revealed three key insights into human-AI collaboration: users treat AI as a thought partner, engaging in iterative prompt refinement; they prefer AI to present options rather than definitive answers; and the creative process with AI is non-linear and emergent. These findings, stemming from user interactions with tools like NotebookLM and Gemini, highlight the need for AI interfaces to support dynamic, exploratory workflows.

title: New ways to plan travel with AI in Search
author: Julie Farago
description: Use new Google AI tools to get help with itineraries, finding flight deals and booking reservations.
summary: Google is rolling out new AI-powered planning and creative tools, including "agentic plans" in Search for complex, multi-step tasks like travel booking and trip planning, allowing users to customize and compare options. Additionally, "Canvas AI mode" in Google Photos enables users to leverage generative AI for image editing and creative projects directly within the app, simplifying complex visual tasks.

title: WeatherNext 2: Our most advanced weather forecasting model
author: The WeatherNext team
description: The new AI model delivers more efficient, more accurate and higher-resolution global weather predictions.
summary: Google DeepMind's WeatherNext leverages AI, specifically its GraphCast model, to significantly enhance weather forecasting accuracy and speed globally. GraphCast, which predicts weather up to 10 days in advance, has been demonstrated to outperform traditional numerical weather prediction systems like the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) on over 90% of key metrics, providing critical support for disaster preparedness and climate research.

title: Google is committing $2.25 million to support AI-ready data in Africa.
description: New funding from Google will help launch a regional Data Commons for Africa.
summary: Google is investing in Africa's AI ecosystem through new initiatives focused on creating high-quality, AI-ready datasets and fostering local talent, critical for developing relevant AI applications. This includes providing grants to African research institutions, collaborating with organizations like DataKind for data annotation, and launching training programs like the AI for Africa initiative to enhance digital literacy and build local AI capacity.

title: Gen AI is bringing New Yorkers' imagination to life
author: Matthieu Kim Lorrain
description: ‘Imagine If…’ lets New Yorkers submit artistic visions of New York City and see them brought to life my local artists.
summary: Google DeepMind's "Imagine If" initiative aims to foster responsible AI development by engaging diverse voices in scenario planning and ethical considerations for advanced AI systems. This program brings together experts from policy, academia, industry, and civil society to explore potential societal impacts and develop frameworks for safely deploying future AI technologies.

title: NotebookLM adds Deep Research and support for more source types
author: Shan Wang
description: NotebookLM adds "Deep Research" for discovering sources, support for Word and PDFs, and a preview of Sheets.
summary: NotebookLM is significantly expanding its content ingestion capabilities, allowing users to upload and analyze a wider range of source materials including Google Docs, Google Slides, PDFs, and URLs, in addition to Google Keep notes. This update enables researchers to conduct deeper, more comprehensive analysis by creating AI-powered summaries, generating questions, and brainstorming across diverse document types.

title: The road to useful quantum computing applications
author: Ryan Babbush
description: An overview of our new framework to help us navigate the pathways and obstacles on the journey to real world quantum computing applications.
summary: Google Research highlights practical applications for quantum computing beyond theoretical benchmarks, focusing on its potential to revolutionize fields like chemistry, materials science, and optimization problems. They emphasize ongoing efforts to develop quantum algorithms that could accelerate drug discovery, create novel materials, and enhance complex logistics, underscoring the shift towards identifying "useful" quantum computing solutions.

title: Google Pixel and Golden Goose partner to  bring AI to global ateliers
author: Google Italy Team
summary: Google Pixel is partnering with luxury fashion brand Golden Goose to integrate AI-powered tools into global ateliers, aiming to enhance creative design and personalize customer experiences. This collaboration will leverage Google's AI capabilities on Pixel devices to assist artisans in ideating, sketching, and customizing products, bridging cutting-edge technology with traditional craftsmanship.

title: Private AI Compute: our next step in building private and helpful AI
author: Jay Yagnik
description: Introducing Private AI Compute, our new way to bring you helpful AI with the power of the cloud, while keeping your data private to you.
summary: Google Private AI Compute introduces a new framework designed to enable AI processing on sensitive data while ensuring robust user privacy through technologies like federated learning and differential privacy. This allows organizations to leverage AI for insights and product improvements without directly accessing raw personal information, addressing critical privacy and security concerns for enterprise and consumer applications.

title: 6 new things you can do with AI in Google Photos
author: Yael Marzan
description: Learn more about new AI tools in Google Photos, including Nano Banana image-generation and more.
summary: Google Photos is rolling out advanced AI features including "Ask Photos," which allows users to find specific photos and memories using natural language queries, and "AI Templates," which provides generative AI-powered tools for creative image editing. These innovations, building on technology like "Nano Banana," aim to make photo organization and enhancement more intuitive and accessible for everyone.

title: Our latest commitments in AI and learning
author: Ben Gomes
description: We’re bringing together experts, students, educators and more at our Google AI for Learning Forum.
summary: Google is reinforcing its commitment to AI education by investing in resources and training programs to help educators and students worldwide understand and responsibly utilize AI. Through initiatives like Google for Education, the company aims to provide accessible learning pathways, develop AI literacy, and equip the next generation with the skills needed for an AI-driven future, emphasizing ethical considerations and practical applications.

title: How AI is giving Northern Ireland teachers time back
author: Lila Ibrahim
description: A six-month long pilot program with the Northern Ireland Education Authority’s C2k initiative found that integrating Gemini and other generative AI tools saved participating teachers an average of 10 hours per week.
summary: Google DeepMind is partnering with schools in Northern Ireland to integrate AI education into their curricula, aiming to foster digital literacy and responsible AI development among students. This initiative, part of a broader effort to equip young people with future-ready skills, focuses on practical AI applications and ethical considerations within the classroom setting.

title: Google is investing in Oklahoma’s workforce and talent pipeline.
description: AI is creating new opportunities for Oklahomans to learn, grow and succeed. Google is committed to making sure the Sooner State is not just ready for this transformation…
summary: Google is expanding its investment in Oklahoma, focusing on workforce development and building a robust talent pipeline through local partnerships and educational programs. This initiative supports the growth of its data center operations in Pryor, Oklahoma, and aims to equip local communities with essential skills for technology jobs, strengthening the state's economic landscape.

title: Opal is now available in more than 160 countries
author: Megan Li
description: We’re bringing Opal to 160 countries.
summary: Google Labs' experimental AI project, Opal, is expanding its availability to over 160 new countries and territories, significantly broadening its reach globally. While specific features are still in development, Opal aims to leverage AI to enhance productivity and organization for a wider user base, reflecting Google's ongoing commitment to bringing cutting-edge AI tools to more people worldwide.

title: Introducing the File Search Tool in Gemini API
author: Animesh Chatterji
description: File Search is a fully managed Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) system built directly into the Gemini API.
summary: Google is enhancing the Gemini API with a new File Search feature, enabling developers to build AI applications that can search and retrieve information across user-provided files within their own services. This integration empowers developers to create more powerful and contextual AI experiences, allowing Gemini models to understand and utilize private, unstructured data sources securely.

title: Create flashcards and quizzes in the NotebookLM app.
description: We’re rolling out a big update to the NotebookLM app this week.
summary: NotebookLM is introducing new AI-powered learning features, including automatic generation of quizzes and flashcards from uploaded source materials, to help users deepen their understanding and retention. These additions transform NotebookLM into a more comprehensive study tool, enabling personalized learning experiences and efficient knowledge consolidation for students and researchers alike.

title: Google Finance adds AI features for research, earnings and more
author: Robert Dunnette
description: Learn more about the new Google Finance, including new features like Deep Search and prediction markets data.
summary: Google Finance is introducing "Deep Search," an AI-powered feature that allows users to conduct highly specific and complex queries for market analysis and investment research. This innovation enables users to explore intricate financial relationships and gain deeper insights into companies, sectors, and economic trends, leveraging Google's advanced AI capabilities for more informed decision-making.

title: AI and learning: A new chapter for students and educators
author: Lila Ibrahim
description: How Google approaches AI and education, from our tools to our commitment to responsibility.
summary: Google outlines its comprehensive vision for integrating AI into learning, aiming to personalize educational experiences, empower teachers with new tools, and develop essential skills for the AI-driven future. The company is investing in research, resources, and partnerships to ensure AI serves as a powerful aid in classrooms, making learning more engaging and accessible for diverse student needs.

title: Our latest fraud and scams advisory
author: Laurie Richardson
description: An overview from Google’s Trust & Safety teams on the most recent online scam trends.
summary: Google's November 2025 advisory highlights prevalent fraud and scam tactics, underscoring its proactive use of AI and machine learning to detect and mitigate these threats across its platforms. The company emphasizes continuous efforts to protect users by identifying malicious content, phishing attempts, and fraudulent schemes, providing practical tips for online safety and security.

title: Improving Structured Outputs in the Gemini API
author: Gemini API Team
description: Today, we're announcing enhancements to Structured Outputs in the Gemini API.
summary: Google is enhancing the Gemini API with structured outputs, allowing developers to receive AI responses in predictable, parseable formats like JSON. This improvement simplifies the integration of Gemini's powerful generative AI capabilities into applications, making it easier to build reliable and robust AI-powered features for diverse use cases.

title: A new report from the Google Threat Intelligence Group shows adversaries experimenting with AI for novel capabilities.
summary: Google's Threat Intelligence Group (TIG) released a report detailing emerging AI-powered threats and the activities of state-sponsored actors leveraging AI for cyber espionage and disinformation campaigns. The report highlights new attack vectors, including the use of generative AI for sophisticated phishing and social engineering, underscoring the critical need for advanced AI-driven defenses and international collaboration to combat these evolving digital dangers.

title: Listen to the Brazilian rainforests and help contribute to AI research
author: Marconi Campos
description: Google Arts & Culture is launching a new Nature & AI experiment that invites people everywhere to listen to the sounds of the Brazilian rainforests to help monitor their biodiversity health
summary: Google Arts & Culture's "Forest Listeners" project employs AI and machine learning to analyze soundscapes from forests worldwide, aiding in biodiversity monitoring and conservation efforts. By interpreting acoustic data, the initiative helps scientists understand ecosystem health, track species, and identify threats like illegal logging, turning ambient forest sounds into valuable ecological insights.

title: Google is helping girls “scout” a path to digital wellbeing.
summary: Google.org is partnering with the Girl Scouts to launch an educational program focused on digital wellbeing, equipping young girls with essential skills for safe and responsible online engagement. This initiative aims to foster critical thinking about technology use, promote healthy digital habits, and empower the next generation to navigate the internet securely and confidently.

title: The latest AI news we announced in October
author: Keyword Team
description: Here are Google’s latest AI updates from October 2025
summary: Google's October 2025 AI updates showcase significant advancements across its product portfolio, introducing new capabilities in generative AI, multimodal understanding, and responsible AI development. These enhancements, spanning areas like search, creativity, and developer tools, underscore Google's ongoing commitment to pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence while prioritizing safety and accessibility.

title: Meet Project Suncatcher, a research moonshot to scale machine learning compute in space.
description: Artificial intelligence is a foundational technology that could help us tackle humanity's greatest challenges. Now, we're asking where we can go next to unlock its fulle…
summary: Google's "Project Suncatcher" leverages advanced AI and machine learning to optimize renewable energy integration and enhance sustainability efforts. The initiative focuses on improving the efficiency of solar energy systems and smart grid management, contributing to Google's broader commitment to operating on 24/7 carbon-free energy.

title: Mixboard is now available in over 180 more countries.
summary: Google Labs' experimental AI music creation tool, Mixboard, is expanding its availability to over 180 additional countries and territories, making AI-powered audio generation accessible to a global audience. This expansion allows more users to experiment with generative AI for music production, enabling intuitive mixing and sound design across diverse regions.

title: New tools in Google AI Studio to explore, debug and share logs
author: Sara Wiltberger
description: We’re introducing a new logs and datasets feature in Google AI Studio.
summary: Google AI Studio is introducing enhanced features for developers, including robust support for managing logs and datasets, streamlining the process of building, testing, and refining AI models. These updates empower developers to efficiently track model performance, iterate on prompts, and curate high-quality training data, accelerating the development of sophisticated AI applications.

title: Chat in NotebookLM: A powerful, goal-focused AI research partner
author: Anuja Agrawal
description: We’re rolling out changes to NotebookLM to make it fundamentally smarter and more powerful.
summary: NotebookLM is receiving a significant upgrade with the introduction of custom personas, allowing users to tailor the AI's behavior and conversational style to better suit specific research or creative tasks. This enhancement, coupled with an underlying engine upgrade, provides a more personalized and effective AI assistant, improving the quality and relevance of generated insights.

title: Accelerating discovery with the AI for Math Initiative
author: Eugénie Rives
description: The AI for Math Initiative brings together five of the world's most prestigious research institutions.
summary: Google DeepMind is advancing AI capabilities in mathematics, demonstrating how AI can solve complex math problems, including assisting with theorem proving and generating novel mathematical conjectures. This research pushes the boundaries of AI's reasoning abilities, opening new avenues for scientific discovery and educational tools in advanced mathematics.

title: Meet the 11 startups using AI to build a safer digital future in Latin America
author: Paco Solsona
description: Learn more about the startups chosen for Google for Startups Accelerator: AI for Cybersecurity.
summary: Google for Startups has launched an "AI for Cybersecurity" cohort, providing mentorship, resources, and access to Google's expertise for promising startups focused on leveraging AI to combat cyber threats. This initiative aims to accelerate innovation in cybersecurity, helping early-stage companies develop cutting-edge solutions for a safer digital ecosystem.

title: Cybersecurity Awareness Month 2025
description: A collection of Google's latest security features and updates for Cybersecurity Awareness Month 2025.
summary: Google is actively participating in Cybersecurity Awareness Month 2025, promoting best practices and offering resources to help individuals and businesses enhance their online safety. The company highlights tools like two-step verification, password management, and AI-powered threat detection to empower users against evolving cyber threats and foster a more secure digital environment.

title: Create on-brand marketing content for your business with Pomelli
author: Bea Alessio
description: Pomelli, our newest experiment from Google Labs and DeepMind, is here to help you create on-brand marketing content.
summary: Google Labs is introducing "Pomelli," an experimental AI project designed to explore novel applications of artificial intelligence in daily tasks and creative endeavors. While specific functionalities are still emerging, Pomelli aims to provide users with intuitive AI assistance, reflecting Google's continuous innovation in developing next-generation AI tools.

title: Google Beam is working with the USO to support military families.
author: Andrew Nartker
description: Learn more about Google’s work with the USO and how it plans to launch a program that will enable service members to stay in touch with loved ones.
summary: Google Beam, an initiative by Google.org, is partnering with the USO to provide digital skill training and resources for military members, veterans, and their families. This collaboration aims to equip service members with essential technology skills for career transitions and personal development, bridging the digital divide and supporting their integration into the civilian workforce.
